optional.name: Fraying Bolt
optional.rule: 1d6 Wyrd; caster movement−5ft until next own-turn start. Deliberate deterministic low-resource basic, not a sample.

optional.name: Sideways Spark
optional.rule: 1d4 Wyrd; optional caster5ft step.

optional.name: Survey the Seam
optional.rule: One visible inert object within10ft: identify one visible seam or likely mechanical load path, not hidden contents or structural immunity bypass; instant information.

optional.name: Fracture Brace
optional.rule: Self ward2 versus next Wyrd assigned damage before next own-turn start; also caster−5ft movement to that start.

optional.name: Lancing Variance
optional.rule: 1d6+2 Wyrd. Deterministic basic giving up a Surge that could bias a set.

optional.name: Chosen Crosscurrent
optional.rule: M:1d6+2 Wyrd and caster5ft step; F:1d6 Wyrd and normal Fracture penalty.

optional.name: Read Instability
optional.rule: Observable anomaly within30ft; choose **one** actual material, rough-boundary or stabilizer fact. No future rolls, hidden identities or invented facts. ID is `cr1_chaos_weaver_read_instability` (alias cw1_07 in tables only).

optional.name: Counterweight
optional.rule: Touch a mundane carried load: +1 to one GM-called noncombat balance/handling check made before end of next own turn; caster−5ft movement to next start. Not advantage, armor or immunity.

optional.name: Discordant Arc
optional.rule: S:2d6+2 Wyrd; F:1d6+2 Wyrd and normal Fracture penalty.

optional.name: Slip Tether
optional.rule: M:caster10ft legal step; F:no step and normal Fracture penalty. Spend both; not teleport or escape from a binding without GM legality.

optional.name: Measured Shelter
optional.rule: Ward4 versus next Wyrd damage before next caster-turn start.

optional.name: Signal Coin
optional.rule: Touch one existing inert token: emits one declared audible click when physically jostled before endT+2, then inert. Does not sense invisible creatures, identify an intruder or create material.

optional.name: Torsion Lance
optional.rule: S:3d6 Wyrd; F:1d6+2 Wyrd and normal Fracture penalty.

optional.name: Skewed Guard
optional.rule: S:ward6; M:ward3 and caster5ft step; F:ward3 and normal caster Fracture. Ward expiry next caster-turn start, one Wyrd event.

optional.name: Inert Margin
optional.rule: One mundane fragile object carried by caster: +2 to one GM-called noncombat check to stabilize it before endT+1; caster−5ft movement to next start. No automatic magical hazard shutdown.

optional.name: Shared Survey
optional.rule: One willing ally within10ft participates in observing one actual visible anomaly within30ft. The table answers two distinct material/boundary/stabilizer questions to both; no hidden knowledge.

optional.name: Resonance Fork
optional.rule: S:3d6 Wyrd; M:2d6 Wyrd and caster5ft step; F:1d6 Wyrd and normal Fracture. Uniform thirds, all spent.

optional.name: Warning Boundary
optional.rule: 5ft anomaly; first enemy voluntary entry: M creates an audible warning and optional caster5ft legal step; F gives caster−5ft to end next own turn. No attack/stop; expiry endT+2; same one-anomaly/dismiss rules.

optional.name: Stabilizer's Kit
optional.rule: Declare one carried mundane tool. +2 to one GM-called noncombat apparatus-calibration check this activity/endT+1. Does not manufacture tools, components or a free rest.

optional.name: Safe Rehearsal
optional.rule: +2 to one GM-called noncombat risk-explanation check about one currently legal published set in this scene, without commitment, tile movement or roll. Merely inspecting odds/branches is always free; this price buys only the check bonus, not access to basic information.

optional.name: Deep Shear
optional.rule: S:3d6+3 Wyrd; F:2d6 Wyrd and caster−10ft until next own-turn start. Stronger branch buys a worse downside.

optional.name: Return Line
optional.rule: Up to15ft legal displacement along a previously observed clear route, using remaining movement. Not teleport, forced escape or obstacle removal.

optional.name: Retune Apparatus
optional.rule: Recover exactly that F and give self ward4 to next caster-turn start. No other tile recovered; deliberately trades Fold's broad recovery for protection.

optional.name: Hold the Sample
optional.rule: Touch an actual inert material sample and preserve its observable arrangement until endT+2 or1-AP release; tile then spent. Occupies the anomaly slot; no living, active magical, temporal or limitless preservation.

optional.name: Crossgrain Ray
optional.rule: S:4d6 Wyrd; M:2d6 Wyrd and caster10ft step; F:2d6 Wyrd and caster−10ft until next start.

optional.name: Passed Opening
optional.rule: Ally may immediately make one10ft legal derived displacement using remaining movement. No additional action, attack, reaction or resource generation.

optional.name: Joint Containment
optional.rule: S:ally ward8; F:ally ward4 and caster−10ft until next start. One Wyrd event, expiry next caster-turn start; no ally tile pool.

optional.name: Trace Disturbance
optional.rule: One visible mundane disturbance/anomaly30ft: identify direction of an actually observable change and one likely local stabilizer. No time travel, culprit identity or divination of future events.

optional.name: Fault Needle
optional.rule: S:4d6+2 Wyrd; F:2d6+2 Wyrd and caster−10ft until next start.

optional.name: Counterseal
optional.rule: End **your own** anomaly: all its bound tiles become spent; S grants self ward6, F grants no ward and caster−10ft to next start. No hostile-effect dispel; impossible if an anomaly trigger is unresolved.

optional.name: Lateral Refuge
optional.rule: M:20ft legal displacement; F:5ft legal displacement and caster−10ft until next start. Remaining movement still bounds both branches.

optional.name: Public Experiment
optional.rule: One visible apparatus/material and willing witnesses10ft: answer three distinct existing observable cause/boundary/stabilizer facts after a GM-adjudicated test. No generated loot or automatic success against an active hazard.

optional.name: Wyrd Crucible
optional.rule: S:5d6 Wyrd; F:2d6 Wyrd and caster−10ft until end next own turn. All three spent; one target.

optional.name: Partitioned Shelter
optional.rule: S:ward10; M:ward6 plus ally5ft derived step; F:ward4 and caster−10ft to end next own turn. One Wyrd event, ward expiry end caster's next turn.

optional.name: Unbind the Test
optional.rule: Safely close **your own** inert Hold Sample/Signal Coin record early; its bound tile, if any, becomes spent; answer one observable failure-mode question. No undo of accepted outcomes or recovery of another caster's contents.

optional.name: Read the Whole Apparatus
optional.rule: Visible apparatus30ft: four distinct existing material/boundary/stabilizer/failure-path questions; no guaranteed correct future outcome, creature mind or unknown history.

optional.name: Finite Cataclysm
optional.rule: S:6d6 Wyrd; M:3d6 Wyrd and caster10ft step; F:2d6 Wyrd and caster−10ft through end next own turn. Uniform ID weights1/2,1/4,1/4; one enemy, no explosion.

optional.name: Sixfold Audit
optional.rule: Touch one visible inert apparatus/real anomaly; choose six distinct observable material/boundary/stabilizer/failure-path questions. Does not reveal hidden actors, passwords or future RNG.

optional.name: Final Safe Passage
optional.rule: M:ally20ft legal derived displacement; F:ally5ft and caster−10ft through end next own turn. All remaining movement/permission constraints stand.

optional.name: Shelter of Alternatives
optional.rule: S:ward14; M:ward8 plus ally5ft step; F:ward6 and caster−10ft through end next turn. One Wyrd event, ward expires end next caster turn.

nodes.name: Measured Reach
nodes.rule: Split enemy range35 /40 /45ft.

nodes.name: Clean Surge
nodes.rule: Split Surge damage flat bonus+1 /+2 /+3.

nodes.name: Read the Fracture
nodes.rule: Split Fracture damage flat bonus+1 /+2 /+3; movement cost unchanged.

nodes.name: Shared Notebook
nodes.rule: Read Instability may answer2 /3 /4 distinct questions instead of1, still actual observable facts.

nodes.name: Bias the Draw
nodes.rule: Grant `cr1_chaos_weaver_bias_draw`.

nodes.name: Extended Bias
nodes.rule: Bias range40 /50 /60ft.

nodes.name: Narrow Lance
nodes.rule: Lancing Variance flat damage bonus+1 /+2 /+3.

nodes.name: Calculated Arc
nodes.rule: Discordant Arc Surge flat damage bonus+1 /+2 /+3.

nodes.name: Shelter Arithmetic
nodes.rule: Measured Shelter ward5 /6 /7 instead of4.

nodes.name: Surveying Rod
nodes.rule: Read Instability range40 /50 /60ft.

nodes.name: Fraying Focus
nodes.rule: Fraying Bolt flat damage bonus+1 /+2 /+3; downside unchanged.

nodes.name: Published Proof
nodes.rule: +1 /+2 /+3 to one GM-called noncombat check explaining a fully published finite distribution per completed-rest interval. No roll alteration.

nodes.name: Guard Equation
nodes.rule: Skewed Guard Surge ward7 /8 /9; other branches unchanged.

nodes.name: Stable Bench
nodes.rule: Stabilizer's Kit calibration bonus+3 /+4 /+5 instead of+2.

nodes.name: Deep Calculation
nodes.rule: Deep Shear Surge flat damage bonus+1 /+2 /+3, not its Fracture branch/cost.

nodes.name: Audited Weights
nodes.rule: Bias the Draw Surge flat damage bonus+1 /+2 /+3; also Closed Distribution's Surge when that capstone is learned.

nodes.name: Declared Margin
nodes.rule: Split Shift legal step10 /15 /20ft instead of5; also Closed Distribution's Shift when learned; remaining movement bounds both.

nodes.name: Closed Distribution
nodes.rule: Grant `cw1_closed_distribution`; does not refresh any once/rest use.

nodes.name: Ground Survey
nodes.rule: Survey the Seam range15 /20 /25ft.

nodes.name: Braced Interface
nodes.rule: Fracture Brace ward3 /4 /5; penalty unchanged.

nodes.name: Material Memory
nodes.rule: Signal Coin jostle signal audible within20 /30 /40ft to normal listeners; no supernatural detection.

nodes.name: Close Observation
nodes.rule: Shared Survey answers3 /4 /5 distinct existing questions instead of2.

nodes.name: Unsteady Ground
nodes.rule: Grant `cr1_chaos_weaver_unsteady_ground`.

nodes.name: Placement Line
nodes.rule: Unsteady Ground placement range40 /50 /60ft.

nodes.name: Broad Etching
nodes.rule: Unsteady Ground radius6 /8 /10ft; still one first enemy trigger.

nodes.name: Written Boundary
nodes.rule: Before placement, Unsteady Ground may select entry OR exit /entry OR exit OR voluntary crossing of its centerline /any of those plus a named boundary segment; exactly one published trigger selected, never several. Newly legal geometry remains manual/unimplemented.

nodes.name: Warning Call
nodes.rule: Warning Boundary's caster step10 /15 /20ft instead of5, only its M branch and remaining movement.

nodes.name: Patient Anchor
nodes.rule: Unsteady Ground expiry endT+3 /T+4 /T+5 instead ofT+2; no extra trigger.

nodes.name: Companion Shelter
nodes.rule: Measured Shelter ward5 /6 /7; same field as P09 uses maximum, not sum.

nodes.name: Careful Seal
nodes.rule: Counterseal Surge ward7 /8 /9; cannot refund anomaly tiles.

nodes.name: Inert Archive
nodes.rule: Hold the Sample expiry endT+3 /T+4 /T+5; still inert-only and one anomaly slot.

nodes.name: Edge Witness
nodes.rule: +1 /+2 /+3 to one GM-called noncombat check to document an actually visible anomaly boundary per completed-rest interval.

nodes.name: Calibrated Reagent
nodes.rule: Retune Apparatus ward5 /6 /7; still recovers only one spent F.

nodes.name: Last Survey
nodes.rule: Warning Boundary placement range40 /50 /60ft; also Last Boundary's placement range when learned; no price reduction.

nodes.name: Deep Etching
nodes.rule: Warning Boundary radius6 /8 /10ft; also Last Boundary radius12 /14 /16ft when learned; still one enemy trigger.

nodes.name: Last Boundary
nodes.rule: Grant `cw1_last_boundary`.

nodes.name: Sideways Reach
nodes.rule: Sideways Spark enemy range35 /40 /45ft.

nodes.name: Sure Footing
nodes.rule: Sideways Spark legal caster step10 /15 /20ft; damage unchanged.

nodes.name: Crosscurrent Hand
nodes.rule: Chosen Crosscurrent M flat damage bonus+1 /+2 /+3.

nodes.name: Counterbalanced Load
nodes.rule: Counterweight's noncombat check bonus+2 /+3 /+4 instead of+1.

nodes.name: Second Possibility
nodes.rule: Grant `cr1_chaos_weaver_second_possibility`.

nodes.name: Passing Distance
nodes.rule: Second Possibility ally step10 /15 /20ft; still one extra M, no extra allowance.

nodes.name: Shared Reach
nodes.rule: Second Possibility predeclared ally range40 /50 /60ft; enemy range unchanged.

nodes.name: Slip the Knot
nodes.rule: Slip Tether M step15 /20 /25ft; no effect on Fracture.

nodes.name: Return Practice
nodes.rule: Return Line legal displacement20 /25 /30ft.

nodes.name: Optional Shelter
nodes.rule: Second Possibility may predeclare an alternative follow-up: spend S for ward3 /4 /5 to its ally until next caster start. Choose S-ward OR M-move before primary commit; exactly one optional result.

nodes.name: Passed Momentum
nodes.rule: Passed Opening ally displacement15 /20 /25ft.

nodes.name: Joint Reading
nodes.rule: Joint Containment Surge ward9 /10 /11; downside unchanged.

nodes.name: Crossgrain Method
nodes.rule: Crossgrain Ray Shift flat damage bonus+1 /+2 /+3; legal movement unchanged.

nodes.name: Refuge Route
nodes.rule: Lateral Refuge M displacement25 /30 /35ft.

nodes.name: One Clear Signal
nodes.rule: +1 /+2 /+3 to one GM-called noncombat check coordinating a predeclared safe route per completed-rest interval; no automatic ally action.

nodes.name: Aftershock Reach
nodes.rule: Second Possibility's primary enemy range40 /50 /60ft; also Single Aftershock predeclared ally range40 /50 /60ft when learned.

nodes.name: Last Continuation
nodes.rule: Second Possibility optional M displacement25 /30 /35ft or learned optional S ward6 /7 /8; Single Aftershock optional M15 /20 /25ft or S ward7 /8 /9 when learned. Still exactly one follow-up, with remaining movement bounding displacement.

nodes.name: Single Aftershock
nodes.rule: Grant `cw1_single_aftershock`.
